title: Bernasconi 2018 trunk PPS with intracranial EEG
citation: Bernasconi, F., Noel, J.-P., Park, H. D., Faivre, N., Seeck, M., Spinelli, L., Schaller, K., Blanke, O., & Serino, A. (2018). Audio-Tactile and Peripersonal Space Processing Around the Trunk in Human Parietal and Temporal Cortex: An Intracranial EEG Study. Cerebral Cortex, 28(9), 3385–3397.
notes: Final journal design with a procedural auditory-only preview. The published experiment required three sternum pulses in each tactile-present trial, passive attention and synchronized clinical intracranial EEG. Research launch is blocked.

study_inventory.cohort: Six adults with electrodes implanted for clinical evaluation of drug-resistant epilepsy.

posture_and_response.posture: Lying in bed with the upper body reclined to approximately 135° relative to the rest of the body.
posture_and_response.instructions: Attend equally to the approaching sound and tactile vibrations.
posture_and_response.response_scoring: None. The outcome was intracranial local field potentials.

auditory_stimulus.signal: Prerecorded white noise approaching from the front, centered on the patient’s body.
auditory_stimulus.binaural_recording: 3Dio Omni binaural microphones and a head model, recording two arrays of eight speakers with a reported combined length of 2 m.

tactile_stimulus.controller: Purpose-made Arduino microcontroller with 10 kHz refresh, controlled by ExpyVR over direct serial.

trial_schedule.nominal_pulse_unit_note: The journal prints the last delay as “2500 m”. Milliseconds follow from the parallel delays and the three-second trial timeline. Distance labels refer to the nominal AT conditions.
trial_schedule.pulse_jitter_rule: Apply jitter to each of the three delays. Choice weights, constraints, independence across pulses and realized jitter sequences are unreported.
trial_schedule.intertrial_interval_rule: Shuffle the reported interval choices. Exact sequence and timing reference are unreported.
trial_schedule.trial_order: The three families were presented in randomized order.

recording_and_analysis.recorder: Micromed System PLUS, with Cz as online reference
recording_and_analysis.offline_reference: Adjacent bipolar depth and strip contacts, local mean reference for each grid.
recording_and_analysis.artifact_exclusion: Exclude electrodes and trials with excessive noise above six interquartile ranges. The exact noise measure and original masks are unreported.
recording_and_analysis.initial_trial_centering: Center each trial epoch to zero.
recording_and_analysis.active_contact_screen: Compare 0–300 ms with −100–0 ms before prestimulus baseline correction. Apply baseline correction to stimulus-locked epochs after identifying responsive contacts.
recording_and_analysis.primary_contrasts: Screen active AT contacts, test AT against A+T for nonlinear integration, then test the AT−A responses at far, middle and close distances by one-way ANOVA in the integration-positive contacts.
recording_and_analysis.complementary_contrast: Test the three-distance AT−A effect in active AT contacts without an integration gate. Use p < .01 for both the active-AT screen and the PPS test in this complementary analysis.
recording_and_analysis.tactile_order_control: Compare the three pulse-order responses within T-only trials to assess expectation or habituation.
recording_and_analysis.temporal_cluster_method: Per-contact FieldTrip temporal permutation procedure, with maxsum and 5,000 resamples. The main cluster criterion is p < .05.

preview_scope.condition: Only the A family is scheduled for inspection. Its 85 rows each use one 3000 ms stereo preview stimulus. Original intertrial timing and block boundaries are outside the preview.
preview_scope.auditory_rendering: The catalog renders white noise along a frontal virtual line with the reported speed and 2 m start. The 2 cm endpoint is calculated from the preview trajectory and the renderer applies inverse-square attenuation. The original recording, amplitude envelope and delivered levels remain unavailable. The local fallback can generate a centered noise clip of the same duration.
preview_scope.legacy_fields: The runtime requires a numeric SOA to build the file preview. The 0 ms placeholder has no experimental meaning. The audio-tactile file derived from it has zero repetitions and is omitted from the preview schedule. The legacy design validator still requires an audio-tactile block.
preview_scope.response: Preview metadata identifies passive attention and disables the response requirement. Published scoring requires electrode-specific local field potentials.

implementation_gaps: The trial scheduler must intermix A, T and AT and deliver three separately timed sternum pulses within each T and AT trial. The sound and pulse timing require a common clock.
The clinical acquisition scheduler must synchronize ExpyVR and Arduino stimulus events to the Micromed iEEG recording and preserve passive observation without behavioral scoring.
Exact source audio, original delivery gains and acoustic calibration, tactile acceleration calibration, hardware latencies and trigger encodings are unavailable.
Exact pulse-jitter allocation, original trial and interval sequence, block structure and alignment of auditory-only epochs to the corresponding tactile events are unreported or unavailable.

A clinical iEEG analysis path requires electrode-specific preprocessing, event-aligned local field potentials, referenced contact masks and the two published integration and PPS analysis paths. The exact masks, remaining supplementary implantation table and original analysis code are unavailable.
